{

  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # macos-15 runs natively on ARM64, exercising the AdvSIMD implementations.
        os: [ windows-latest, ubuntu-latest, macos-15 ]
        build-configuration: [ Debug, Release ]
    outputs:
      latest-version: ${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}
    environment: ci
    env:
      SOLUTION_PATH: MimeKit.sln
      BUILD_PLATFORM: Any CPU
      BUILD_CONFIGURATION: ${{ matrix.build-configuration }}
      GENERATE_CODE_COVERAGE: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && matrix.build-configuration == 'Debug' }}
      MONO_RUNTIME: ${{ matrix.os != 'windows-latest' }}
      MIMEKIT_REQUIRE_ARM64_SIMD: ${{ matrix.os == 'macos-15' && '1' || '0' }}
      PUBLISH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && matrix.build-configuration == 'Release' }}

    steps:
      - name: Setup/Install the .NET SDKs
        id: install-netsdk
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            10.0.x

      - if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        name: Setup MSBuild
        id: setup_msbuild
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3

      - name: Checkout repository
        id: checkout_repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: Get semantic version from csproj
        id: semantic_version
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $xml = [xml](gc MimeKit/MimeKit.csproj)
          $SEMANTIC_VERSION_NUMBER = $xml.Project.PropertyGroup.VersionPrefix
          $VERSION_NUM = $SEMANTIC_VERSION_NUMBER[0].Trim()
          Write-Host "version_num=${VERSION_NUM}"
          [IO.File]::AppendAllText($env:GITHUB_OUTPUT, "version_num=${VERSION_NUM}$([Environment]::NewLine)")

      - name: Run .NET restore
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet restore $env:SOLUTION_PATH

      - name: Run .NET tool restore
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet tool restore

      - name: Build solution
        id: build_solution
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet msbuild $env:SOLUTION_PATH -property:Platform=$env:BUILD_PLATFORM -property:Configuration=$env:BUILD_CONFIGURATION -property:MonoRuntime=$env:MONO_RUNTIME

      - name: Run unit tests
        id: run_unit_tests
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          & ./scripts/test.ps1 -Configuration "$env:BUILD_CONFIGURATION" -GenerateCodeCoverage "$env:GENERATE_CODE_COVERAGE"

      - name: Upload unit test results
        id: upload_test_results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: MimeKit.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.build-configuration }}-TestResults.xml
          path: TestResult.xml

      - if: ${{ env.GENERATE_CODE_COVERAGE == 'true' }}
        name: Upload code coverage data to coveralls.io
        id: upload_to_coveralls
        run: |
          & ./scripts/coveralls.ps1
        env:
          COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN }}
          GIT_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GIT_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          GIT_ACTOR: ${{ github.event.head_commit.author.username }}
          GIT_ACTOR_EMAIL: ${{ github.event.head_commit.author.email }}
          GIT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
          COVERALLS_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}

      # The unit test step uses continue-on-error so that the test results and code coverage data
      # still get uploaded, but the job should still fail if any of the unit tests failed.
      - if: ${{ steps.run_unit_tests.outcome == 'failure' }}
        name: Fail if unit tests failed
        id: check_unit_tests
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Write-Output "::error::One or more unit tests failed. See the 'Run unit tests' step for details."
          exit 1

      - if: ${{ env.PUBLISH == 'true' }}
        name: Create NuGet packages
        id: create_nuget_package
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          nuget pack nuget/MimeKit.nuspec -Version "$env:LATEST_VERSION.$env:BUILD_NUMBER"
          nuget pack nuget/MimeKit.Core.nuspec -Version "$env:LATEST_VERSION.$env:BUILD_NUMBER"
          nuget pack nuget/MimeKit.Cryptography.nuspec -Version "$env:LATEST_VERSION.$env:BUILD_NUMBER"
        env:
          LATEST_VERSION: ${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}

      - if: ${{ env.PUBLISH == 'true' }}
        name: Push NuGet packages to MyGet
        id: push_nuget_package
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          nuget push $env:MIMEKIT_CORE_PKG_PATH -ApiKey $env:MYGET_API_KEY -Source https://www.myget.org/F/mimekit/api/v3/index.json
          nuget push $env:MIMEKIT_CRYPTOGRAPHY_PKG_PATH -ApiKey $env:MYGET_API_KEY -Source https://www.myget.org/F/mimekit/api/v3/index.json
          nuget push $env:MIMEKIT_PKG_PATH -ApiKey $env:MYGET_API_KEY -Source https://www.myget.org/F/mimekit/api/v3/index.json
        env:
          MIMEKIT_PKG_PATH: MimeKit.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg
          MIMEKIT_CORE_PKG_PATH: MimeKit.Core.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg
          MIMEKIT_CRYPTOGRAPHY_PKG_PATH: MimeKit.Cryptography.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg
          MYGET_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MYGET_API_KEY }}

      - if: ${{ env.PUBLISH == 'true' }}
        name: Upload NuGet packages as artifacts
        id: upload_nuget_package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: nuget-packages
          path: |
            MimeKit.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg
            MimeKit.Core.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg
            MimeKit.Cryptography.${{ steps.semantic_version.outputs.version_num }}.${{ github.run_number }}.nupkg",

Adding actions/cache for ~/.nuget/packages after checkout and before restore preserves every build and test step and all coverage/publish behavior, adds no secrets or privileged actions, and does not introduce new network access (it reduces repeated fetches from nuget.org).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
